R6V-grouse-walk-0002.name: 370 m E of Four Mile River
R6V-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
18 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Dease Lake. Closed May 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 1-51/23.
Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Hot Lakes, Cassiar, Adsit Lake, Midway Mine and One Ace Mountain. Closed May 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 1-52/23.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 471 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.17168, -129.79986, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk 38 km to the start. Walk: the unnamed road stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 84 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-23, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2025-06-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R6V-grouse-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-23: about 2,351 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.21 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
